run_pointnav_birdseye_view: run example_pointnav_draw_target_birdseye_view to visualize agent and goal positions on a birdseye map
run_birdseye_view_agent_on_border: run example_pointnav_draw_target_birdseye_view_agent_on_border to draw birdseye views with agent on map edges
run_get_topdown_map: run example_get_topdown_map to generate and display a recolorized topdown map from the Habitat simulator
run_top_down_map_measure: run example_top_down_map_measure to navigate an agent with shortest path following and record a video
review_ShortestPathFollowerAgent: review the ShortestPathFollowerAgent class that wraps ShortestPathFollower to extract optimal navigation actions
